Item: How will the cabinet meet a sloped ceiling or wall?
Prompt / specification: A square cabinet needs a controlled reveal or fit part where the room is irregular. Options: Keep the box square and fit a separate scribe or crown zone | Use an oversized finished end at one exposed side | Rack the cabinet until both corners touch

Doors help verify reveals but add weight and can obstruct safe lifting and fastening. Options: Fit and label doors on the bench, then remove them for hanging | Install doors only after the boxes are hung | Lift fully loaded cabinets with doors and shelves installed
